## 4.4. Descriptive Statistics and Correlations

80,9% of the participants are upper level manager. Rest of them are middle and lower level manager. Their average age is 41,18. 46,19 of the   respondents are bachelor; 22,79 of them have master , 92,8 have PhD degree. 57,49 of the respondents have more than 5000 TL (23300 $) of monthly income, 16,3 % of them have 4000-5000 TL and 19,9 % of them have 3000-4000 TL monthly income. 349 of the respondents have an experience more than 15 years and 20,69 of them have an experience of 5-10 years .
